comment: Both P samples sit on dots of dotted A (lpt22): (859,3199) on the dot at u 853-866 v 3195-3203 and (853,3269) on the dot at u 850-858 v 3264-3275. Told apart by the 17-18 px dot pitch (dots at v 3200 3218 3234 3252 3270 3286 3304 drifting toward the frame); solid B ends at about (854,3127); long-dash D is in a dash gap at v 3189-3203 and not visible after v 3228; dashed C runs to the right (u 867-875 at v 3199; gap at v 3256-3269).

Two bends: corner 1 at (1076,1767) where the 72 deg rise turns into a straight 45 deg segment (u 1095 to 1143) and corner 2 at (1177,1674) where that segment turns into the plateau. P is on bend 1 about 20 px up-curve from its corner. Q is on the straight 45 deg segment 52 px from corner 2 (it is the curve point nearest the steep-rise and plateau tangent intersection at (1098,1666)). Local-bend reading favors p; the plateau knee would be neither.

Q sample (862,3054) is on solid B (lpt23): row 3054 run 852-867 is long-dash D (852-860) plus B (about 858-867). B is followed by continuity through D dash gaps (B left edge 861-862 at v 3002-3014; B alone at u 856-866 at v 3065-3077) and continues down to about (854,3127), so the sample is mid-line.

Two bends: the trough bottom at (1315,2025) where Q sits (flat from u 1308 to 1326) and the recovery knee where the rise steepens, curvature peak at about (1345,2016) (13 to 45 deg, then 64 deg past the dash gap). P is on the straight 64 deg dash about 49 px past that knee and 12 px past the small turn across the dash gap at (1371,1989). If the knee is meant neither mark is at it (put it at (1345,2016)); if the minimum is meant Q is right.

(1618,1537) is on the lower end of a C (lpt24) dash (row 1537 ink u 1613-1623; dash runs up to v 1440). (1688,1417) is on the next C dash (ink u 1684-1695) that runs to the top frame. Both follow C's long-dash short-gap pattern; dotted A ends in dots just left at (1604,1542) and (1612,1523) and no dots continue above v 1520.

One broad bend of long-dash D (lpt25) with no straight part between the marks: dash angles about 65-70 deg below v 1900, 62 deg (dash with P), 48 deg (dash with Q), 35 deg, 25 deg. P (1068,1864) is the curve point nearest the steep-rise and gentle-part tangent corner (about 1045,1846); Q (1120,1805) is near the local curvature peak between dashes 3 and 4. Both on the same bend.

(850,3210) is on a D (lpt25) dash at u 847-854 v 3204-3228, just right of the frame edge (u 846). It fits D's dash period (gap at v 3189-3203, 61 px after the gap at v 3128-3140). In rows 3207-3212 and 3225-3227 dotted A is in a dot gap, so this ink is not A, and solid B has ended at v 3127.
Column u 1228 has D (lpt25) dash ink from v 1747 to 1758; (1228,1752) is mid-stroke on the dash from (1192,1773) to (1233,1745), 5 px inside its upper end.

(1450,1570) is inside the D dash at u 1441-1473 v 1543-1585 (column 1450 ink about v 1565-1579). (1386,1652) is where D crosses solid B: D's left edge in row 1652 is u 1372 and the D stroke is 13-14 px wide horizontally, so its right edge is near u 1385; the sample is within 1-2 px of D ink (also on B's upper edge). D is followed through the crossing by its ends above (1387,1639) and below (1360,1675) B.

lpt24 is the dashed line the label arrow touches at (865,2732); its dashes, tracked down the right of the bundle with about 60 px period, end in a last dash at u 772-781 v 3101-3130 with lower end (776,3130). (763,3144) is on a separate stroke at u 757-766 v 3137-3148 (white at u 767-790 below v 3131) that continues the long-dash lpt73 whose previous dash ended at (772,3089). Not lpt24 ink.

(749,3135) is 2 px inside the frame (u 743-751) and 3 px from any visible trace ink: off. (755,3100) is on ink beside the frame (row 3100 u 752-763, the solid core) where long-dash lpt73 is in a dash gap: its dashes run just right of the solid core in phase with lpt24, the last one ends at (772,3089) and the next starts near (769,3104), so the sample is about 15 px left of the lpt73 path.

Dotted lpt74 joins the bundle at about (850,2592) and shows no separate dots below that, so it cannot be followed to the origin. (754,3099) is on the solid core ink beside the frame; (751,3138) is on the frame edge with white to its right, about 2 px below the end of that ink (u 752-757 at v 3136). Neither can be tied to the dotted line.
